sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2024
sources.text: Five robbers armed with a knife, boarded a ship underway. They took hostage and tied up one of the crew. Alert crew raised the alarm and crew mustered. Hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s engine spare parts. Incident reported to Singapore VTIS.
